package deps // import "github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom/pkg/lang/deps"

Package deps reads direct file dependencies using a caller-supplied repository
view. Results disclose uncertainty so consumers can widen or run when inputs are
incomplete. The package performs no toolchain calls, closure or hashing.

VARIABLES

var ErrInput = errors.New("invalid dependency input")
    ErrInput identifies malformed arguments or options. Its errors never echo
    caller-supplied text.


TYPES

type DecidableBy string
    DecidableBy names evidence that could resolve an unknown.

const (
	Toolchain   DecidableBy = "toolchain"
	Lockfile    DecidableBy = "lockfile"
	ConfigFile  DecidableBy = "config-file"
	Observation DecidableBy = "observation"
	Declaration DecidableBy = "declaration"
)
type Edge struct {
	From       string     `json:"from"`
	Kind       Kind       `json:"kind"`
	Raw        string     `json:"raw"`
	To         string     `json:"to"`
	Resolution Resolution `json:"resolution"`
	Version    string     `json:"version"`
	Line       int        `json:"line"`
	Provenance Provenance `json:"provenance"`
}
    Edge is one direct dependency. From is a repository-relative slash path.
    To is a logical repository path or an external ecosystem:name ID. Version
    is populated only from a lockfile or manifest pin. Line is one-based,
    with 1 used for file-wide evidence.

type FileDeps struct {
	Path     string    `json:"path"`
	Dialect  string    `json:"dialect"`
	Measured bool      `json:"measured"`
	Trusted  bool      `json:"trusted"`
	Complete bool      `json:"complete"`
	Edges    []Edge    `json:"edges"`
	Unknowns []Unknown `json:"unknowns"`
}
    FileDeps holds a file's sorted edges and unknowns, including empty arrays.
    Complete requires zero unknowns and either passing admission (Measured) or
    explicit opt-in to an unmeasured reader (Trusted).

type Input struct {
	Path    string
	Dialect string
}
    Input names a repository-relative file. A blank Dialect infers the reader
    from Path where possible.

type Kind string
    Kind is the dependency construct.

const (
	Import     Kind = "import"
	Include    Kind = "include"
	Embed      Kind = "embed"
	BuildInput Kind = "build-input"
	Exec       Kind = "exec"
	ConfigRef  Kind = "config-ref"
)
type Option func(*readerOptions) error
    Option configures a Reader at construction.

func TrustUnmeasured(dialect string) Option
    TrustUnmeasured opts into one implemented, unmeasured dialect's results.
    Unknowns still prevent completeness, and failed admission cannot be waived.

func WithDeclaredEdges(edges ...Edge) Option
    WithDeclaredEdges adds direct edges for the specified source paths. To must
    identify a logical target. A version must be a manifest or lockfile pin.

func WithResolver(dialect string, resolver Resolver) Option
    WithResolver replaces import resolution for an implemented dialect.
    An unimplemented dialect still lacks the detector needed for completeness.

type Provenance string
    Provenance names the provider of an edge.

const (
	Builtin   Provenance = "builtin"
	Pack      Provenance = "pack"
	Extension Provenance = "extension"
	Declared  Provenance = "declared"
)
type Reader struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Reader holds immutable per-dialect options. Its zero value uses defaults.

func New(opts ...Option) (*Reader, error)
    New constructs a dependency reader. By default it trusts no unmeasured
    dialect.

func (r *Reader) ReadFile(ctx context.Context, repo fs.FS, file, dialect string, src []byte) (FileDeps, error)
    ReadFile reads source bytes, consulting only repo for resolution. Dialect is
    explicit when provided. Blank dialect infers from the logical path.

func (r *Reader) ReadFiles(ctx context.Context, repo fs.FS, inputs []Input) ([]FileDeps, error)
    ReadFiles reads a non-empty batch of distinct files in logical path order.
    An unreadable file appears as incomplete and the batch returns an error.
    A canceled read returns the completed prefix and the context error.

type Resolution string
    Resolution describes the target's identity.

const (
	File          Resolution = "file"
	Directory     Resolution = "directory"
	External      Resolution = "external"
	UnknownTarget Resolution = "unknown"
)
type Resolver interface {
	Resolve(repo fs.FS, from, raw string) ([]Edge, *Unknown)
}
    Resolver resolves a detected import against the supplied repository view.
    It returns targets and/or a typed unknown. The reader owns source, line, raw
    operand and provenance. A version must come from a manifest pin or lockfile.
    Callers sharing a Reader must supply concurrency-safe resolvers.

type Unknown struct {
	From        string        `json:"from"`
	Code        UnknownCode   `json:"code"`
	Raw         string        `json:"raw"`
	Line        int           `json:"line"`
	DecidableBy []DecidableBy `json:"decidable_by"`
}
    Unknown discloses missing evidence. An empty DecidableBy grants no trust.

type UnknownCode string
    UnknownCode gives the reason a file's dependency evidence is incomplete.

const (
	DynamicImport        UnknownCode = "dynamic-import"
	ComputedPath         UnknownCode = "computed-path"
	UnresolvedAlias      UnknownCode = "unresolved-alias"
	MissingConfig        UnknownCode = "missing-config"
	UnboundedGlob        UnknownCode = "unbounded-glob"
	UnsupportedConstruct UnknownCode = "unsupported-construct"
	ParseError           UnknownCode = "parse-error"
	UnmeasuredReader     UnknownCode = "unmeasured-reader"
	ExternalUnpinned     UnknownCode = "external-unpinned"
	ReadLimit            UnknownCode = "read-limit"
)
